The system displays the configuration interface for global auction rules.
The Auctioneer defines or modifies shipping options, bid increments, and payment methods as required.
The Auctioneer saves the configured settings.
The system validates the input data and updates the global auction rules in the database.
The system confirms the successful update of the global auction rules to the Auctioneer.
The global auction rules (shipping options, bid increments, payment methods) are successfully updated in the system database.
The system displays a confirmation message to the Auctioneer indicating the settings have been saved.
The new configuration settings become the default parameters for all subsequent auctions created by the Auctioneer.
